title: Cursor path
description: An oversized pointer travels a curved path over a screenshot or screen recording, hovering each target (an accent outline lands around it), clicking with a ripple and showing a short label, while the camera pushes in toward each stop. Give `background` (a bin file id) and `points` on the targets; without a background it plays over a drawn editor screen. For product walkthroughs and UI demos.

background.description: Screenshot or screen recording to point at (file id); without one a drawn editor screen is used.

points.description: Where the pointer stops, in order, as fractions of the frame (x 0-1 from the left, y 0-1 from the top); without a background, fractions of the drawn screen.

labels.description: Short label shown at each stop (empty item: none).

zoom.description: How far the camera pushes in toward each stop (1: no camera move).

cursor_size.description: Pointer size (1 = 88 px on a 1080 frame: big enough to follow on a phone).

clicks.description: Click at each stop (false: hover only).

target.description: Width of the hover outline around each stop, px at 1080.
